column1: # Hand-written labels and search tags for every asset — read by cut.ts and
# relabel.ts (which check it first: duplicate ids, empty labels, stray tabs or
# commas stop the run). Tags are comma-separated; remove=yes takes an asset
# out of the library and keeps its raw file, so it can come back.
# Ids are opaque keys made from the raw filename: "animals-adorable-15904" is
# a toy chick, and that is fine. Don't rename them, or the raw files —
# either orphans the row, and its label quietly stops applying.
